Your movie-night information

Voting uses a random anonymous identity stored in your browser. We store one ballot per film and voting round under that identity. We do not ask for your name or email to vote. Clearing site data or using another browser creates a new identity.

For RSVPs and email subscriptions, we verify your email address. Hosts can see guest names, email addresses, suggestions, and bookings. Guest contact lists are not public. The screening location is public, so hosts should share a street address privately if needed.

Supabase stores the application data and handles sign-in. Resend delivers verification emails, invitations, reminders, and screening cancellation notices. Cloudflare Turnstile checks for automated signups. These providers may process technical information such as IP addresses for delivery and abuse prevention. The application does not maintain its own IP tracking list.

Posters load from TMDB or a host-selected image URL; your browser shares normal request information with the image provider. GitHub Pages serves the website. We do not use advertising analytics.

You can cancel your seat on the website and unsubscribe from invitations and reminders using the link in any movie email. Unsubscribing does not cancel an existing seat; essential cancellation notices for your booking may still be sent. Contact your hosts to request deletion of your stored information. Hosts retain records until they delete them; there is currently no automatic retention period.
